function dropSession(host, s): void

Defined in: website/components/home/about/glitch/session.ts:216

Tears a session down in place — stops the loop, destroys the wasm widget, disconnects the observer, removes the overlay and un-parks it from the host. Used by the wasm arm when every backend failed and by disarmGlitch for normal teardown.
